name: Daniel Agasi
title: Brand & Performance Marketing
tagline: Result-driven marketing leader with 5+ years of experience in F&B, lifestyle, and tech sectors. Specializing in high-impact performance marketing with proven results up to 11x ROAS.
bio: I'm Daniel Agasi — a marketing leader based in Jakarta who bridges creative strategy with technical execution. Over 5+ years I've driven measurable growth for F&B, lifestyle, and tech brands across Indonesia and internationally, managing cross-functional teams of 15+ and delivering consistent results that go beyond vanity metrics.

experience.description: Overseeing digital strategy for premium F&B brands: AB Steak, Akira Back, Yen Signature, and Urban Roots. Peak achievement: 11x ROAS for Yen Social Bali via Google Ads.
Directed global marketing and audience development for an AI platform across European and U.S. markets. Collaborated with product teams on GTM strategy.
Led agency growth and creative direction, delivering story-driven marketing with measurable impact. Managed and scaled digital performance for key accounts including Adhya Group's F&B portfolio.
Led a cross-functional team of 15 across Live Shopping and Performance Marketing divisions. Managed end-to-end digital strategies for 10+ brands, consistently exceeding ROI/ROAS targets.
Led digital marketing for B2B tech giants including Microsoft, Adobe, and Autodesk. Achieved 140+ keyword rankings on page one and 90+ performance scores across 3 corporate sites.

services.title: Performance Marketing
services.description: Full-funnel paid media strategy and execution across Meta, Google, TikTok, and LinkedIn. Proven track record up to 11x ROAS for F&B, lifestyle, and tech brands.

services.title: SEO
services.description: Technical and strategic SEO that drives sustainable organic growth. Delivered 140+ Page 1 keyword rankings for enterprise tech brands including Microsoft and Adobe.

services.title: Web Development
services.description: Conversion-optimized websites built for performance. Experienced with Webflow, WordPress, and Framer — delivering fast, beautiful sites that rank and convert.

services.title: Brand & GTM Strategy
services.description: From market research to full go-to-market execution. I help brands define their positioning, build their playbook, and launch with measurable impact.

faqs.question: What industries have you worked in?
faqs.answer: I have deep hands-on experience in F&B (premium restaurants, cafes, bakeries), tech (Microsoft, Adobe, Autodesk), lifestyle brands, and AI/SaaS — both in Indonesia and international markets.

faqs.question: What's your strongest result to date?
faqs.answer: 11x ROAS for Yen Social Bali via Google Ads, and consistent 7x average ROAS for multiple Medan-based F&B brands. I also achieved 140+ Page 1 keyword rankings for enterprise tech clients.

faqs.question: Do you work remotely or internationally?
faqs.answer: Yes — I've worked as a Regional Marketing Lead for a US-based AI platform (ShowOnAI) and am comfortable with async remote collaboration across time zones.

faqs.question: Do you take freelance or consulting projects?
faqs.answer: Yes, I take on select freelance and consulting engagements. Send me a brief at agasidaniel2@gmail.com and we'll see how I can help.
